Pairs: all 7 menlo-bold-italic-fallback pairs pass at the merge and are carried from review-2.json with unchanged source and golden SHA-256. The 5 failing fallback residue cases remain under checker-opus-2/residue, outside the executable walk.

Integration 6484bb7e0 is a single-parent squash onto parity-recovery 32684f81e carrying review/opus-g3-recheck 4761d217b; 4761d217b is not an ancestor. Reproducing the merge with git merge-tree gives a clean merge everywhere except text_render.rs; the committed tree differs from that result only in text_render.rs. class.rs, sequence.rs, state.rs, svg.rs, usecase.rs, plantuml_metrics.rs, menlo_bi_fallback.rs and lib.rs are byte-identical to the G3 tip; face_cmap_tables.rs and bullseye.yaml are byte-identical to 32684f81e; creole.rs carries every changed line of both sides (multiset check, 0 missing). No file is deleted relative to either parent.

Ratchet fix: the test explicit_font_monospace_decodes_to_dialog now binds `let dialog_base = base(26.0, 76.6016);` once and derives the Menlo base from it (`let mut menlo = dialog_base;`), so the pre-existing literal is the only one. With the guard's own counting rule text_render.rs has 51 literals at 505999cac, 68 at 32684f81e, 52 at 4761d217b and 68 at 6484bb7e0; every rustuml-render file count at the merge equals 32684f81e, and the decimal_literal_ratchet listing is identical to 32684f81e (class.rs 383->578, deployment.rs 43->44, plantuml_metrics.rs 1053->1055, state.rs 53->61, text_render.rs 51->68). The fix is minimal and test-only. The 51->68 text_render.rs line itself is pre-existing at parity-recovery (G2/G6), not caused by this merge.

Conflict resolution: trim_text_for_emit, text_width_for_style and tab_stop_width keep G3's style_face call; style_face now takes bold/italic from effective_bold/effective_italic, which return the atom's own bits when Style::owns_font_configuration is set and base||style otherwise. write_text_element keeps G6's effective_bold/effective_italic/effective_underline.
